notes.title: Regular Updates 20250429
notes.content:
Hello,

Map Pack and Sandbox Editor are now available. Players who previously pre-paid will receive this DLC as a complimentary gift. Thank you for being so supportive!

Version 0.92.022 Major Updates:
1. Fixed an issue where USD payments displayed incorrect amounts.
2. Significant update to the troop recruitment system: the food mechanism. In addition to military expenses, recruiting and upgrading troops now require food resources. Different unit types consume varying amounts of food, requiring commanders to make strategic trade-offs in battle.
3. Added new avatar components.
4. Fixed a potential issue with equipment display when cross-playing with PC.
5. Fixed some UI text display issues.
6. Fixed several localization errors in text.

notes.title: Important Announcement: Transition of the Game to Free Download.
notes.content:
Hello,

It has been more than a year since we last updated the Default branch of the game. Some players have asked in the community and forums whether the development team has abandoned this project.

The answer is "No, we haven't."

We have been continuously developing and testing new systems. However, since the new content involves a lot of networking and cross-platform functionality, we've had to invite players to test it through the test branch 'daily_build' while it remains unstable.

We apologize that our Early Access development approach over the past year has prevented most players from experiencing game updates immediately. While this was a necessary measure, we're happy to announce that this phase is coming to an end.


Today, we have some important news to share with you:
[list][*][b][color=#FF0000]Extremely Realistic Siege Warfare Simulator will receive a major update at 10:00 AM CST on April 17 (6:00 PM PST on April 16) and will become free to download.[/color] [/b]
[*]We have successfully ported the game to mobile devices with cross-platform multiplayer support for PC players. The mobile version will be rolled out globally throughout this year.[/list]
While we have much to share with our dedicated players, we've decided to keep this 
announcement concise. As a token of our gratitude to all pre-paid players who have supported us throughout the years, we're pleased to present the following Thank You rewards:

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36833049/6daeb1f044c258767cd2e8d84a698bc3223ab92c.png[/img]

[olist][h3][*] ‘Prepaid Reward’ Package:[/h3]
[list][*] [color=#00FF00]68 Jade[/color] : Can be used to purchase an Elite Commander Pass Bundle, unlocking unit content previously available in the paid version and granting a large number of rewards.
[*] [color=#00FF00]Sandbox Editor & Map Pack DLC[/color] .
[*] [color=#00FF00]600 Gem[/color]  (approximate value worth $18)；
[*] [color=#00FF00]A special profile avatar component.[/color] [/list]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36833049/85e9fed0e4b70cdfe4b27be50c33ee89c8096805.png[/img]
The above rewards will be distributed via the in-game mail system to all players who purchase the game before April 17, 2025 and have more than 2 hours of gameplay. 

[h3][*]  ‘Supporter Reward’ Package: [/h3]
[list][*] [color=#00FF00]30 Jade[/color] 
[*] [color=#00FF00]An additional 680 Gem. [/color][/list]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36833049/8f2c62566ca8ef5a1e9d9c9cb3b0933d16134b8e.png[/img]
The Supporter Reward Package will be sent via a separate system mail to all players who purchased the game before January 1, 2025, in support of the development team.

[h3][*]  ‘Dedicated Supporter Reward’ Package: [/h3]
[list][*] [color=#00FF00]30 Jade[/color] 
[*] [color=#00FF00]12 Gratitude Tokens can be used to redeem equipment skins.[/color] 
[*] [color=#00FF00]Dedicated Supporter Avatar Components. [/color] [/list]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36833049/f25aa65e37c59fa9cf775c8432ff7d263bfd9e9e.png[/img]
The Dedicated Supporter Reward Package will be distributed to all early supporters who purchased the game before January 1, 2024. [/olist]

Developing the online multiplayer features of Extremely Realistic Siege Warfare Simulator has been a very big challenge indeed, and we are very grateful for all the support and companionship that we have been receiving. 
We currently have a very large number of tasks to complete for the upcoming update, and we will explain more about the game update through future announcements. 

[h2]Q&A on Transitioning to Free-to-Play[/h2]

[b]Q: [/b]Why convert the game to free-to-play? 
[b]A: [/b]Over the two years of Early Access development and testing, the game has gone deeper and deeper into online multiplayer gameplay. We want it to be easier for people to find teammates when playing online, and easier for them to recommend this game to their friends to come and play together. We don't want a pre-paying cost to be a hindrance to that. 

[b]Q: [/b]Is the sandbox mode available to play for free?
[b]A: [/b]The Sandbox Editor will be bundled with some maps and sold separately as a DLC. All players who previously purchased the game to support the development team will receive this DLC as a complimentary gift. 
However, given that the development team is currently overwhelmed with work, we are concerned that we might not be able to complete everything by the time the game transitions to free-to-play. But rest assured—once we finish testing and packaging the DLC, we will make it available to everyone immediately. 

[b]Q: [/b]What paid content will be available in the game? 
[b]A: [/b]Currently, the in-game purchases mainly include a pass to unlock all units, some unit equipment skins, and profile avatar gacha items. We want to allow players who wish to support the development team to dress their troops in more stylish outfits, but changing equipment will not affect gameplay stats. Spending is entirely optional—please feel free to contribute based on your preference and ability. 

[b]Q: [/b]Can all units be unlocked without purchasing the pass? 
[b]A: [/b]No, we recommend that players consider the free-to-play version as a trial edition of the game.All currently developed unit types in the game will be bundled into a permanent Battlepass which called Battle Commander Pass. Before purchasing this pass, players will only be able to use a portion of the units in the game. 
However, the free version offers some flexibility when unlocking units—you will be able to choose one of two options in certain unit categories. This design aims to ensure that players who may have difficulty making purchases or those in regions with economic constraints can still select their preferred units and enjoy battling with others. 


[b]Q: [/b]Can the free version support online multiplayer?
[b]A: [/b]Currently, we do not charge for online multiplayer services. 
However, server traffic costs are a significant expense. If the financial pressure from server fees becomes too high in the future, we may need to limit the playtime of free players in online multiplayer sessions.

notes.title: “RISE OF AI”！Enjoy the massive wave of updates！July 18 Major Updates
notes.content:
Hello Commanders!

In past months you all have been conquering a lot and acquire a long list of victories, now it is time to extend and update the war! Adding more ways and experiences there with the updates you will be able to explore and discover more possibilities, new soliders are waiting for your order, with new skills & weapons you will find more strategy ideas, customize a campaign now with the new AI and function supports, now in multiplayer games you could also chat with txt, live wars! And get ready for the bots attack! You will now be able to add bots to battle! And lots of new maps and optimizations! Ultimate wars and fun! Start it now! !   

https://youtu.be/HQ3D_1ZW8_c

[b]Special features from the latest update : AI in Sandbox and Play against Bots[/b]

- Now players can configure AI in Sandbox mode which would allow players create interesting levels/maps and wars with more logistic and more ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36833049/259700249ab98489410b254eb77e7dbc0bb4b37b.png[/img]

- In 13 maps, players will be able to add bots to war, like traditional RTS games, players now can try more strategy and ideas with opponent who would play with at anytime, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36833049/7c30176c8d7c5b5f06dcad9f3474da609e379664.png[/img]

[b]Level & Map Updates [/b]
[list]
[*] New Update: Play against Bots. You can now engage in battles and experience the thrill of PvP gameplay against AI-controlled enemy teams. Challenge yourself in single-player encounters or team up with friends in online multiplayer matches to take on AI opponents together. 
[*] New Update: Resource Vehicle Capture. 
[*] New Update: 7 new Encounter Levels added. 
[*] New Update: 7 new Co-op maps added. 
[*] New Update: 14 new PVP maps added. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36833049/92d08d086116701deb15e79b8a0f92227e102624.png[/img]
（General updates up-to-now review）

[b]New units & advanced units[/b]
[list]
[*] New Update: Basic unit added - Camel Rider.
[*] Added advanced training unit: Heavy Infantry for Shieldmen.
[*] Added advanced training unit: Heavy Armored Spearman for Spearman.
[*] Added advanced training unit: Heavy Armored Flailman, and Vanguard.
[*] Added advanced training unit: Elite Archer for Archer.
[*] Added advanced training unit: Master Crossbowmen for Crossbowmen
[*] Added advanced training unit: Heavy Armored Cavalry for Cavalry.
[*] Added NPC - Training Officer, in Encounter and multiplayer games. You can train certain basic units into new advanced units at the Training Officer.
[*] Added NPC - Slave Trader, in both single-player and multiplayer games. You can redeem defeated commanders through the Slave Trader.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36833049/804043e2b3e367d165e65c936910b1ca7887aab2.png[/img]

[b]New Items & Skills[/b]
[list]
[*] Added construction item: Arrow Tower.
[*] Added construction item: Temporary Shop. With the Temporary Shop, you can purchase supplies on the frontline during battles.
[*] Added a series of construction items that can change the terrain environment during battles: Camp Gate, Advanced Barricade, Watchtower. Use these items flexibly to freely construct frontline in the game.
[*] Added consumable item: Tonic Capsule. It resets the number of soldier skills and cooldown time.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36833049/ded08ddd54f5a5059e2f7fe993b99a1d81a5c232.png[/img]

[b]System updates and game optimizations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the menu UI for unit upgrades, adding slots for active skills and the ability to adjust their order. You can adjust them to update the shortcut keys for skills.
[*] Updated the menu UI for the item shop. Now units can purchase up to 4 active items, and you can change the shortcut keys for item usage by adjusting their order in the slots.
[*] Added the advanced action F6 to demolish your own buildings.
[*] Updated the control method for Cavalry Possession.
[*] Added chat function in multiplayer games. Press the "Enter" key to bring up the chat window. Press "Enter" again when the text input is empty to close it.
[*] Updated the tent recovery mechanism. If not all soldiers of a squad enter the tent and the squad chooses to leave the tent, the units that did not enter the tent will maintain their current state without recovery.
[*] Modified the tent recovery mechanism when the commander dies. When entering the tent, the commander will be the last unit to revive. If the squad leave the tent early, the commander will not immediately revive.
[*] Added a mechanism where the speed of siege equipment decreases when the number of operators is not enough.
[*] Besides the gate itself, the frame of the gate can now also be destroyed. You can now shatter both the walls and the main gate.
[*] Numerous UI adjustments to accommodate 21:9 displays.
[*] Numerous updates to battle effects.
[*] Numerous game values adjustments.
[*] Many bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

[b]Sandbox mode feature updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Update: Sandbox Manual. You can find it in the top left corner of the sandbox interface. We have provided some basic explanations of the sandbox's features.
[*] New Update: AI configuration features. You can configure richer AI behaviors for computer-controlled units.
[*] New Update: Scene Data features. This includes Points, Paths, and Supervising Zones. These are necessary map information for configuring AI and enemy generators.
[*] New Update: Enemy generators and related features. You can continuously create enemies after the game starts using enemy generators.
[*] New Update: Building events. You can trigger AI switches for computer-controlled units using building events or trigger enemy generators. For example, creating defensive units inside the castle when the player breaks down the main gate, or having patrol units counter-attack when the player mounts ladders on the castle walls.
[*] New Update: Recruitable NPCs, Advanced Training NPCs, Merchant NPCs for the squads. You can use them in sandbox games and encounter battles or PvP battles with upgradable units.
[*] New Update: Selection Mode. You can select all objects on the map in this mode, quickly view and edit their properties.
[*] New Update: Map Information Display Filter. You can use this feature to hide certain scene objects that may distract your view. This feature is especially useful when the map content is complex.
[*] New Update: Map Size Adjustment. You can conveniently modify the map size while editing the terrain.
[*] Expanded the map size to 36x36 grids. This is a very large size, and in most cases, you won't need to create such a large map. Also, please note that excessively large map sizes can impose a heavier burden on your CPU during AI pathfinding.
[*] New Update: Adjusting building health percentage feature. You can use this feature to utilize the damaged models of buildings.
[*] Expanded the number of teams to 8.
[*] Added a large number of terrain assets.
[*] Added a large number of unit equipment assets.
[*] Added experience drop and gold drop attributes to the unit editing feature. If you configure these attributes for a unit, the killing force will automatically receive gold and experience for leveling up when that unit is killed.
[*] Polished many interactive processes.
[*] Fixed numerous issues discovered during testing.
[/list]

We would like to thank you all for all supports since the game launch, we have been working a lot to keep updates to the game and we do have confidence the game will grow to one of the best warfare simulator game while with lots of funs and joys. Here is a glance of what we are currently working on with which we aiming to provide more and better experiences to the game. looking forwards to your feedback on reviews, discussions, and welcome to join our Discord channel!

notes.title: The multiplayer demo has been released！
notes.content:
This Demo includes a series of new tutorial gameplay, involving changes to the game over the past six months.
The main changes are as follows:

1. Advanced Instructions. Now you can give your troops more precise commands: advanced commands such as move, lock-on attack, and stay in place.
2. New siege weapon gameplay. Siege weapons are now a neutral unit and you need to have your troops occupy them before you can use them. This is a feature that has not been fully developed, we will polish it in the future.
3. Items. Troops can use consumable items, and you can buy them in the multiplayer store. At present, we have only completed a small part, and we will continue to develop more interesting items in the future.
4. Multiplayer. This is the biggest change in the game, and it is our most important work in the past six months. In this demo, we provide 1 multiplayer co-op map and 4 PVP maps. More gameplay will be added to the game in the future. Now you can invite your friends to play together.

This is our first multiplayer game, and the server and the game build maybe not be well-prepared. If you encounter connection problems, I hope to get your understanding, we are working hard to improve.

Other contents in development:
1. Sandbox mode. We will invite players to playtest next month, if you are interested, welcome to join our Discord.
2. Custom units. We will provide soldier characteristics and cosmetic equipment customization in the sandbox mode next month. We will gradually add more customizable contents in the future.
3. Workshop. Of course the game will support Workshop. We will provide lot of customization and level editing tools, so that you can make your own game levels and play with friends.

Looking forward to playing with you in Extremely Realistic Siege Warfare Simulator!

notes.title: Demo is closed, thanks for your support!
notes.content:
Dear commanders,

The Steam Next Fest is now over, and [i][b]Extremely Realistic Siege Warfare Simulator DEMO[/b][/i] has closed on June 23. Thanks to everyone who played!

This is our first time to test the game. Due to the limited time, we can only finish the DEMO content and then go online in a hurry. We still need to improve the game guidance, sound effects, UI and other aspects. At the same time, we are very sorry that the Demo version also appeared more bugs~

[h1]Some NUMBERS about this demo[/h1]
[list]
[*] According to Steam background data, over 10,000 players have played the game (thank you for your support!).
[*] Most of them are from China, followed by North America and Western Europe
[*] 1000 players played it for more than 1 hour, thank you very much!
[/list]

[h1] Our Future Plan [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix bugs and optimize the content of the demo
[*] Continue to develop new features such as online game and mode
[*] Prepare for the next test
[/list]

Thanks again and we'll see you in the next beta!
